nodes.description: Public view function isContract(address addr) returns bool; reads the code size of addr via inline assembly extcodesize and returns whether it is greater than zero.
Address parameter of isContract; supplied by the caller and passed into the assembly extcodesize instruction.
Uninitialized uint local variable inside isContract that receives the extcodesize result from inline assembly.

edges.reason: The caller-supplied addr parameter flows into the isContract function body where it is used as the operand of extcodesize.
Inside isContract the extcodesize result is assigned to the local variable size, and size is subsequently read in the comparison size > 0.

normalization_plan.reason: The addr parameter has no independent security meaning and is used only as the input of the isContract function's extcodesize computation, so it should be merged into the isContract function node.
The local variable size is a transient holder of the extcodesize result that is only read within isContract, so it should be merged into the isContract function node.
